newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Amgen EPS view raised. [CORRECTED 07:45 GMT 19/4]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Amgen EPS view raised. [CORRECTED 07:45 GMT 19/4]

text.p: (Corrects headline and text to indicate a rise rather than a cut in earnings estimates. Also corrects all figures.)

-- Everen Securities Inc said Friday it raised earnings estimates for Amgen Inc to $2.85 a share from $2.77 for 1997, to $2.87 from $2.84 for 1998, and to $2.94 from $2.89 for 1999. The rating remains market perform.
-- Everen said a change in a marketing partnership could cause a flattening in Amgen's earnings per share.
